2 top defensive shotguns - Mossberg 590A1 & Remington 870 - Hickok45

If you're looking for a defensive shotgun, you do not want a double barrel shotgun. Here are 2 of the absolute best available for defensive shotguns. They are effective, absolutely reliable, harder to miss with than a pistol and can be loaded with various ammo types to suit you. Anyone can operate these confidently with a little practice. Simply one of the best home defense options available.

And if your broke as shit. Mossberg Maverick 88. I think the only difference between it and the 590A1, is made in Mexico instead of the US, bead sights instead of ghost rings, non metal trigger guard, and safety placement. The Mav you can get used for less than $200. New at Walmart they are like $250. Also all the mossberg 500 parts fit, barrels, stocks, etc.

Also Mossberg 500's are plentiful on the used market. They don't have the heavy wall barrel, ghost ring sights, bayonet lug and other extras that the 590A1 has but they have the reliability and same overall design.

Rem has steel receiver, moss has aluminum. Steel is stronger, heavier, and rusts. Winner there is arguably Mossberg.

Mossberg ejector can be r&r'd with a screwdriver. Rem can't.

Rem has two action bars. Moss has one.

Rem has metal trigger guard. Moss (500) is plastic. Can be upgraded to metal as in 590.

Moss magazine can't be extended.

Moss shell lever stays out of the way while loading.

Tang safety on moss. Trigger safety for Rem. I prefer tang.

Rems are prettier in my opinion, and more iconic.

Moss seems like the better design.
